answer: The sable chain is verified at intake and kernel publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 10 epochs old, anchored at a quill checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 10 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That bill is paid per identity, so 269 aliases cost 386 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
